notes.title: Big new bug patch incoming
notes.content:
Hi all!

Just an update that there will be an upcoming patch to fix various bugs and errors in the game. Shoutout to SamuelHans and other players who have been pointing out bugs. :D

File size for the update will be negligible.

notes.title: Version 1.02 now available
notes.content:
Patch notes:

- Fixed a glitch involving the arcade entrance on day 16

- Fixed various typos in the journal

- Altered some code to make bugs involving summonable allies occur less frequently

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Patch 1.01 released to fix several issues, including:
[list]
[*] A glitch in Day 19 where the player is able to enter the caverns twice
[*] Bugged turrets for the support class 
[*] A soul jar that can be sold multiple times
[*] various typos and errors.
[/list]

notes.title: Update: Windows BETA is Ready, Mac Version Coming Very Soon
notes.content:
Hi all,
 
Great news, the closed beta for windows is ready on both Steam and Itch.io. The Mac version is postponed slightly due to some technical issues, which may require me buying a new Mac to fix. 
 
If you want a beta key, contact me on my discord channel here: [url=https://discord.gg/azkt8RD]https://discord.gg/azkt8RD[/url]. Got 100 spare keys so it's first come first serve.
 
What you should expect from the Beta:
 
[list]
[*] The first phase of the Beta will cover the first full 1/3 of the game. As the test period progresses, I will update the Beta until it covers 100% of the game, and eventually, towards full release. I am attempting to do this in such a way where testers can download new files and pick up where they left off, with all of their progress intact, when an update drops, but bugs may occur.

[*] There is currently no hard level cap. Players may level up their characters all the way to the soft cap of level 20 (after which no new features, skills or non-stat benefits appear). Leveling past that will result in stat bonuses.
 
[*] All items will be available for sale in the shop early in the game. This may not persist into the final build, and prices will change.

[*] This is a Beta, so there can be any number of bugs, glitches, typos, etc. I have not identified any game breaking bugs yet, but they may exist. 

[*] Some placeholder graphics/UI/animations, etc. If something looks a bit odd or unfinished, it may be a placeholder.

[*] Combat should be intuitive for players accustomed to turn-based RPGs, but details are available in-game through the journal. 
 
[*] Yet-to-be implemented features. The most notable of which is the Trauma System.

[/list]
